title: IT Manager, Middleware Platforms
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.


The IT Applications Manager is responsible for the operational stability, performance, and continuous improvement of a defined portfolio of business applications. This role leads and develops a small team, partners closely with business and IT stakeholders, and ensures services are delivered in line with agreed SLAs and industry’s best practices. The Manager drives problem management, application lifecycle management, and improvement initiatives while maintaining strong technical understanding, service ownership, and customer focus.


**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Owns support and service performance for assigned portfolio, ensuring incidents, requests, problems, and non‑project changes are delivered reliably against SLAs and KPIs, minimising business impact and improving customer satisfaction.
* Drives operational excellence and stability by analysing support trends, leading problem management and root cause analysis, strengthening knowledge management, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives that reduce recurring issues and increase efficiency.
* Building strong stakeholder relationships, understanding business priorities and application criticality, communicating clearly, and escalating risks appropriately to enable confident business operations.
* Leads and develops a high‑performing team, providing coaching, technical guidance, and accountability while fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous capability growth.
* In collaboration with solution architects, ensures applications lifecycle is managed effectively with solution architects and vendors, and overseeing upgrades, enhancements, regulatory changes, security, and project delivery to align technology outcomes with business strategy.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8\+ years of experience supporting and managing business applications and platforms , preferably in enterprise environments (e.g., Product Lifecycle Management such as PTC Windchill; clinical systems; integration/ middleware platform s such as TIBCO, BizTalk, MOVEit).
* 1\+ year of experience leading a technical or operations team of 5 or more team members , with accountability for team performance, coaching/feedback, and people\-management responsibilities (including hiring/termination decisions and partnering with HR on employee relations, as applicable).
* Extensive knowledge of IT operational procedures and platform management, including defining team operating standards and ensuring required processes are followed.
* Strong understanding of related IT processes and/or equipment, with the ability to optimize processes and tooling across areas of responsibility.
* Ability to define and integrate metrics into projects and operations to demonstrate IT value and service performance.
* Ability to communicate and interact professionally across all organizational levels, escalating issues and risks appropriately.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, matrixed, and continuously evolving environment.
* Ability to provide technical guidance to employees, colleagues, and/or customers.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Demonstrates knowledge of IT best practices. Familiarity with ITIL principles or certification is an advantage.
* Strong interpersonal skills; accountable, committed, and customer\-focused.
* Strong analytical/problem\-solving skills; lead incident and problem management (major incidents, RCA, corrective/preventive actions).
* Proactive and positive; takes ownership to drive issues to resolution.
* Self\-directed and goal\-oriented; prioritizes work based on business impact and urgency.
* Clear written and verbal communicator; collaborates effectively across teams and functions.
* Comfortable in SLA\-driven support environments; manages priorities and expectations.
* Strong stakeholder management; communicates status, risks, and trade\-offs to business and technical partners.
* Plan and execute upgrades/migrations with change control, risk management, and post\-implementation review.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e.g., pandemic protocols, Environmental Health \& Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Startdatum: z.s.m.


Bij JINC geloven we dat ieder kind gelijke kansen verdient. Om onze maatschappelijke missie waar te maken, hebben we een sterke en goed georganiseerde interne organisatie nodig.


Daarom zoeken wij een HR Specialist die graag meedenkt over het ontwikkelen, verbeteren en borgen van HR\-beleid, en dit weet te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en een zorgvuldige uitvoering. Daarnaast voel jij je thuis in salarisadministratie en zorg je ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel en correct verloopt.


Heb jij oog voor detail, neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid en wil je met jouw HR\-kennis bijdragen aan een organisatie met echte maatschappelijke impact? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

**Dit ga je doen**


Als HR Specialist ben jij dé inhoudelijke expert op het gebied van salarisadministratie en HR\-processen. Je zorgt dat alles achter de schermen klopt en alles goed is vastgelegd. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega´s van HR, waarbij iedereen met zijn eigen specialisme bijdraagt aan een sterk HR binnen JINC.

* Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:
* Het verwerken en beheren van de salarisadministratie, bij voorkeur in AFAS;
* Borgen van correcte toepassing van arbeidsrechtelijke en salarisgerelateerde wet\- en regelgeving;
* Opstellen, actualiseren en beheren van HR\-beleid, richtlijnen en procedures;
* Beheer en optimalisatie van HR\-processen en administratieve workflows;
* Signaleren van risico’s en verbetermogelijkheden binnen HR\-administratie en systemen;
* Samen met het team denk je mee over en geef je vorm aan diverse HR\-thema’s.

 **Wat breng jij mee?**

* Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen HR en/of salarisadministratie;
* Aantoonbare ervaring met salarisadministratie en verschillende HR\-thema’s;
* Kennis van HR\-systemen; ervaring met AFAS is een sterke pré;
* Goede kennis van relevante wet\- en regelgeving;
* Je werkt nauwkeurig, analytisch en gestructureerd en bent beleidsmatig sterk;
* Beleidsmatig en analytisch sterk: je vertaalt inzichten naar concrete HR\-oplossingen
**Het HR\-team**  

Als HR\-adviseur kom je te werken in een gedreven en gezellig team van HR\-professionals. Ons HR team \- jouw directe collega’s \- zijn Fatma (HR adviseur), Aniek (HR Adviseur), Kelsey (HR Adviseur), Anouk (HR Stagiaire), en Joyce (Teamleider HR).


We werken twee vaste dagen op kantoor (Utrecht) en zijn ook regelmatig op andere JINC\-vestigingen door het land te vinden. We beginnen iedere week met een weekstart en iedere ochtend met een gezamenlijke dagstart.  

Je 200\+ nieuwe JINC\-collega’s zijn gedreven, gemotiveerd en houden van verbinden en samenwerken. Bovendien zijn we intrinsiek gemotiveerd in ons streven een inclusieve organisatie te zijn en blijven.

**Wat bieden wij jou**
----------------------

  

* Een impactvolle baan in een **inclusieve** organisatie. En een betrokken en energiek team dat samenwerking belangrijk vindt.
* Bij ons ben je nooit uitgeleerd: met een ruim **trainingsaanbod en loopbaanbudget** stimuleren we jouw groei.
* Een salaris volgens de cao Sociaal Werk. De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 7 (€ 3\.132 tot maximaal € 3\.290 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur). Bij aantoonbare senioriteit en ruime ervaring in de functie is inschaling in schaal 8 bespreekbaar.
* Daarnaast zorgen we goed voor je toekomst met een uitstekend pensioenplan.
* Met een **individueel keuzebudget** van 17% kies je zelf: extra vrije dagen, een opleiding of een salarisboost.
* Een tijdelijk contract van 12 maanden met de intentie om voor langere tijd met elkaar het avontuur aan te gaan.


Je standplaats is Utrecht, maar je reist ook regelmatig naar onze vestigingen. Hiervoor krijg je een NS Business Card tot je beschikking.

**Inclusiviteit**


Bij JINC streven we naar een organisatie die een afspiegeling is van de samenleving. We moedigen iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, seksuele oriëntatie, beperking of overtuiging. We kijken vooral naar wie jij bent en wat jij meebrengt.

 **Enthousiast?**


Ben jij enthousiast om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan de missie van JINC? Aarzel dan niet en solliciteer meteen door op de actieknop rechts van deze pagina te klikken.


In het wervingsproces, beginnend met een telefoongesprek, gevolgd door in\-person gesprekken op kantoor en het maken van een casus, krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden en enthousiasme te laten zien.


Sollicitaties worden doorlopend beoordeeld; bij voldoende geschikte aanmeldingen sluiten we de vacature.


We kijken ernaar uit om jou te ontmoeten en te ontdekken hoe je bij ons team past.


Heb je vragen over het sollicitatieproces? Neem contact op met het HR\-team.


Een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag is vereist voor alle functies bij JINC. De kosten hiervoor worden vergoed.


Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

**Meer weten over de functie? Neem contact met ons op**

title: Manager- Talent Acquisition Business Partner
description:
**Job Title Manager \- Talent Acquisition**
-------------------------------------------


Career Level: D3


Introduction to role


We are looking for a results\-driven Recruitment Manager (IC) to independently manage end\-to\-end hiring while partnering closely with business stakeholders. This role focuses on delivering high\-quality talent through effective sourcing, strong stakeholder management, expertise in AI platforms and data\-driven recruitment practices. Ready to shape how we attract the people who power life\-changing science?

**Accountabilities**
--------------------


Lead and execute end\-to\-end recruitment for a defined portfolio, from intake briefing through to offer and onboarding, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers.


Partner with business leaders to understand workforce needs, advise on market insights and design targeted hiring strategies that balance speed, quality and diversity.


Use AI platforms, digital tools and data to build sourcing strategies, track funnel performance and continuously improve time\-to\-hire and quality\-of\-hire.


Manage the country relocation process for new hires, coordinating with internal partners and external vendors to ensure a smooth transition.


Conduct interviews and pre\-selection assessments, providing clear recommendations based on role requirements and behavioural fit.


Oversee offer management, including negotiation within policy, and ensure all hiring administration is accurate, compliant and timely.


Collaborate with colleagues across the global recruitment community to share best practices, pilot new approaches and drive innovation in how we attract talent.


Good experience with ATS platforms \& AI based hiring tools like LinkedIn AI / Hiring Assist etc.


Champion our employer brand in every interaction, ensuring candidates experience a transparent, respectful and engaging process. This applies to both lateral \& campus recruitments alike.

**Essential Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------


Develop strong relationships within the Global Recruitment organization to gather input for creating effective marketing strategies, processes, and standards to measure success.

* Ensure all communication messages and materials provide consistent messaging aligned with the corporate position and adhere to the brand guidelines.
* Facilitate responses and engagement within recruitment\-related social network platforms by monitoring activity, collaborating with relevant teams, and drafting accurate responses.
* Assist managers in analyzing recruitment channels such as employee referral programs, job boards, social networks, events, advertisements, websites, emails, and campaigns to optimize performance.
* Coordinate and deliver the Global Employee Referral Program, ensuring the process is effectively executed across targeted segments within the organization.
* Collaborate with Recruitment Marketing agencies to develop or review all communications intended for candidates, applicants, and new hires, ensuring alignment with recruitment brand strategies and messaging.
* Gather and analyze candidate feedback from multiple sources to enhance recruitment strategies and communication effectiveness.
* Strategically contribute to College Relations and participate in career fairs and conferences to maintain brand consistency and optimize outreach efforts.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------


Experience working with AI\-enabled sourcing or recruitment platforms.


Background in managing end\-to\-end recruitment in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


Exposure to relocation processes or mobility coordination within a country.


Familiarity with data\-driven recruitment metrics and dashboards.


Comfort working in cross\-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without direct line management.


When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to


inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge


perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that


doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual


flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


At AstraZeneca, talent professionals join a global community that powers the enterprise to move faster and smarter for patients every day. Working alongside bright, digitally savvy colleagues, there is freedom to experiment with new technology, apply data\-driven thinking and turn ideas into reality at pace. Curiosity is encouraged, smart risks are supported, and impact is visible as better hiring directly enables scientific breakthroughs that change lives. With varied projects, room to grow in different directions and recognition for strong performance, this is a place where ambitious self\-starters can build a powerful reputation while contributing to something that truly matters.


If this role sounds like the next step in your journey, apply now and help shape the future of talent at AstraZeneca!

**Who We Are**

**Logicwise Works** builds digital products that work for real users, at scale, with engineering quality that we take seriously. We are a small, high\-standards team operating in a competitive market where AI is reshaping what clients expect and what engineers must deliver.

We do not hire for headcount. We hire for people who want to grow fast, think independently, and build things that matter.

**The Honest Reality of This Role**

This internship is not a classroom. We will not walk you through every step. You will be given real problems, expected to think them through, and held to quality standards that reflect what clients actually need not just what training exercises require.

There will be pressure. There will be moments of uncertainty. That is intentional.

If you are looking for a structured, hand\-held learning experience, this is not the role. If you are looking for the fastest way to become a developer who can genuinely deliver, read on.

**What You Will Do**

* Own tasks end\-to\-end. Understand what you are building, why it exists, and who will use it before writing code
* Think before execution. Define goals, users, risks, and success criteria
* Test your work against real\-world expectations, not just functionality
* Use AI tools to improve productivity, debugging, and output quality
* Work on live project components with increasing independence
* Raise problems early and communicate what you have already tried
* Continuously improve your technical foundation

**Who We Are Looking For**

Technical skills are the entry point. We primarily evaluate how you think and how you learn.

C1: Critical Thinking

* You question assumptions, identify real constraints, and ensure your solution solves the actual problem.

C2: Curiosity

* You go beyond surface\-level understanding and explore why things work the way they do.

C3: Creative Thinking

* You find alternative approaches when standard solutions do not fit and think beyond given instructions.

**Non\-Negotiable**

* Genuine curiosity about how things work
* Ability to attempt problem\-solving independently before asking for help
* Self\-learning experience outside formal education (projects, tools, concepts)

title: Junior BIM Engineer
description:
Job Title: BIM Modeler

Department: VDC

Job Description: As a BIM Modeler in the civil engineering domain, you will play a key role in the creation, coordination, and management of digital models that represent various stages of building and infrastructure projects. You will collaborate closely with architects, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate and effective project development. Your proficiency in BIM software and your understanding of civil engineering principles will contribute to the successful execution of projects.

​

Responsibilities:

​

* Develop accurate 3D models of building and infrastructure elements using BIM software (e.g., Autodesk Revit, Bentley MicroStation) based on project specifications, design drawings, and engineering data.
* Integrate relevant data, including dimensions, materials, structural details, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) components, and other relevant attributes into the BIM model.
* Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, and other project stakeholders to ensure interdisciplinary coordination and clash detection, resolving any conflicts in the digital environment before construction begins.
* Generate 2D drawings and documentation derived from the BIM model, including plans, sections, elevations, and construction details, ensuring alignment with project standards.
* Create visual representations and renderings of BIM models to help stakeholders better understand design intent, construction sequencing, and project progress.
* Extract quantities of materials and components from the BIM model to support cost estimation, procurement, and scheduling.
* Update and maintain the BIM model throughout the project lifecycle, reflecting design changes, field modifications, and as\-built conditions.
* Review and validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of the BIM model and associated documentation.
* Engage in regular communication and coordination meetings with project team members to ensure a smooth workflow and address any BIM\-related concerns.
* Provide assistance and training to colleagues regarding BIM software usage and best practices.

Qualifications:

​

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field.
* Proficiency in BIM software, such as Autodesk Revit, Bentley MicroStation, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of civil engineering principles and construction processes.
* Familiarity with industry standards, codes, and regulations related to building and infrastructure design.
* Attention to detail and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work within project deadlines and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* In this role, you'll contribute to the transformation of traditional construction practices by leveraging technology to improve project outcomes, reduce errors, enhance collaboration, and streamline construction processes.

* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP

title: Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Business Analyst
description:
****Capgemini is seeking a skilled Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Business Analyst to join our dynamic team.****
 The successful candidate will play a vital role in bridging business requirements and technology solutions within banking and financial services projects, particularly focusing on Temenos TAP implementations and enhancements. We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have experience working in TAP Wealth management solution. These roles represent a unique opportunity build your career as a Banking I.T. professional and gain further exposure to some of the world's top banking institutions.
   

  

 As a vital part of our business unit, you'll contribute to first\-class end\-to\-end solutions in your assignments. You will play an active role in defining our practices, standards and ways of working, and apply them to your role. Be open to working across organisation and team boundaries to ensure we bring the best to our customers.
   

  

 Our Banking and Diversified Financials practice helps clients shape, define and deliver banking transformation initiatives across the entire span of the organisation (front office to back office). This encompasses driving process improvement and process digitisation to enhance customer experience and delivery straight\-through digital processing and self\-service across the bank.
   

  

 Key areas of focus are around wealth management, payments, structured products and money market products. Working closely with clients, product owners, and technical teams, you will gather, analyze, and document business processes and requirements to ensure successful delivery of banking software solutions aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities include:**
* Provision of specific TAP expertise to enable delivery teams
* Gather requirements from the Business and work, document them with work with the TAP technical teams to translate the end user requirements to application/system requirements
* Reviewing requirements documents provided by the clients
* Build customization on TAP solution using the TAP scripting language
* Performing code reviews, creating code review standards,
* Mentoring and guiding the developers to adhere to the coding standards
* Training the team members in TAP Business Analysis
* Configuring TAP GUI, TAP WUI, Financial Servers and eco\-system components like WTX / TTI / Actuate etc
* Expertise in configuring \& tailoring Strategies, Constraints, PTCC checks, Formats, Screens, Reports etc covering various F2B \& B2f processes for Asset classes Securities, derivatives, Forex products, structured products, forwards and spots, money market products
* Documenting functional specification and Test artefacts
* Expertise in preparing meaningful, concise and aesthetically pleasing power point presentations
* Conduct functional trainings on TAP
* Collaborate with partners within and outside Capgemini to build assets \& accelerators


**Requirements**
**Functional Skills:**
* Minimum 10\+ years' experience as a TAP WUI or GUI SME with a large organisation
* Minimum 5\+ years of non\-TAP experience, preferably in Wealth Management, acting as BA Lead for at least 2 years.
* Strong analysis skills with wealth expertise, possessing significant work experience and in\-depth knowledge of wealth products like securities, Bonds, Mutual Funds, Structured Products, Derivatives, Forex, forwards, spots etc
* Understand the Wealth Management and Private Banking business and eco system \- Custodian, Depository, Broker, Registrar etc
* Experience preparing good quality Functional Design/Technical specifications/Test cases
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum in particular and the use of Jira
* Able to work as Team player as well as independently without any supervision


**Soft Skills:**
* Strong client management skills
* Confident and articulate \- excellent verbal and communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Able to build relationship with business stakeholders and other team members
* Ability to lead a team


**Benefits**
 Competitive compensation and benefits package:
   

  

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Retirement Benefits
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Performance Bonus


 Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 59\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22\.5 billion in revenues in 2025\.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About Plane**
 Plane is an incisive response to config\-heavy, opinionated, and restrictive project management software. Check out our website.
   

  

 In just two years, Plane’s grown to \#1 in its category on GitHub and become a viable open\-core alternative to Jira, Monday, Wrike, Asana, ClickUp, and Linear, not to mention all\-in\-one tools like Notion or Obsidian.
   

  

 Our growth has come on the back of the product’s true flexibility without artificial limits, simple configurations that work out of the box, and thoughtfully packaged features that nurture our customers’ growth instead of punishing it.
   

  

 As a modern product start\-up, we obsess over new and power users equally. Our mission is to empower teams everywhere with the simplest, most delightful work management experience on the planet. Our vision is to become the WorkOS of the future with a workbench of unified tools and techniques that intuitively and progressively form a greater whole for knowledge workers.
   

  

 We’re well capitalized, backed by OSS Capital, and are revenue\-positive. Our coworkers include ex\-Microsoft, Deloitte, \[24]7, Nutanix, and Yahoo! in our 50\+ strong human force today.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Were looking for a Junior Frontend Engineer who is early in their career but already shows real hunger for the craft of building software. This is a role for someone who wants to work on a product that thousands of teams rely on, learn from engineers who care deeply about quality, and grow quickly by taking on meaningful, well\-scoped problems.
   

  

 You wont just be picking up tickets. Youll contribute to real user\-facing features, pair with senior engineers on harder problems, and steadily take on more ownership as you grow. Our expectation is that within a year, youll be shipping features end\-to\-end with confidence.
   

  

 Youll work directly with designers, product managers, and other engineers in a tight feedback loop, and your work will reach hundreds of thousands of users and thousands of teams globally.
   

  

**What Youll Do**
* Build user\-facing features. Implement user\-facing features across our product, contributing to UI components, data models, and API integrations. Youll start with well\-scoped work and gradually take on larger, more ambitious surfaces as you grow.
* Contribute to our sync and real\-time collaboration layer. Work alongside senior engineers to help extend our data synchronization mechanism and collaborative editing tools, which use a local\-first architecture. Youll learn how modern sync engines, serialization, and conflict resolution actually work in production.
* Learn and apply browser\-level performance techniques. Get hands\-on with Service Workers and IndexedDB for caching, and contribute to making Plane feel fast on slow networks and functional when users are offline.
* Help push UI performance. Profile and optimize rendering paths — virtualization, memoization, selective re\-renders — guided by senior engineers and our performance goals. Complex, dense views are a core part of Plane, and keeping them smooth is a shared responsibility.
* Add instrumentation to what you ship. Help build out analytics, monitoring, and alerting around new features so the team can spot issues early. Youll learn to think about observability as part of shipping, not as an afterthought.
* Work with our TypeScript tooling and build pipeline. Get comfortable with Vite and Rolldown, and contribute to keeping our developer experience fast and our production bundles lean.
* Participate in our open\-source work. Plane is open\-source at its core. Youll contribute patches, review community PRs, and help us maintain a healthy public codebase.
* Grow into strong engineering habits. Write clear code, ask good questions in reviews, document your work, and adopt the testing and review practices of a senior engineering team from day one.


**What Youll Bring**
* 2–4 years of professional frontend experience, with a portfolio of work (production apps, side projects, or open\-source contributions) that shows you can ship real software.
* Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and React. Youre comfortable with modern React — hooks, component composition, context — and you write TypeScript with intent rather than just appeasing the compiler.
* Working understanding of routing and state management. Practical experience with React Router and at least one client\-side state management library (MobX, Redux, Zustand, or similar). You should be able to reason about when state belongs local vs. global and how reactivity flows through your app.
* Comfort writing modern CSS. You can build responsive, themeable UIs and are comfortable with utility\-first CSS (Tailwind) or a similar modern approach.
* Good instincts for design and UI details. You dont have to be a designer, but you should notice when something feels off — a misaligned element, a clumsy empty state, a jarring transition — and care enough to fix it.
* A curious, prototyping mindset. Youre the kind of engineer whod rather build a small, working version of an idea than argue about it in the abstract.
* Comfort working in a small, fast\-moving team. You can take ownership of a task, ask good clarifying questions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction.
* Attention to detail and a craft mindset. You care about the small things — the empty states, the loading behavior, the micro\-interactions — because they add up to how the product feels.
* A learners attitude. Youre eager to pick up new tools, unafraid to ask questions, and open to feedback in code review and beyond.


**Nice to Have**
* Contributions to open\-source projects, even small ones.
* Exposure to rich\-text editor frameworks (ProseMirror, CodeMirror, Lexical, Tiptap).
* Familiarity with Service Workers, IndexedDB, or offline\-first app patterns.
* Experience with Electron or desktop app packaging.
* Prior experience on project management, productivity, or collaboration products.


**Our Tech Stack**
**Frontend**
* React with TailwindCSS, using hooks for composable functionality
* React Router for client\-side routing
* MobX for binding the data model to the UI
* ProseMirror\-based content editor
* Electron for the desktop application


**Backend \& Infrastructure**
* Django/Python, Golang, and Elixir services


**PostgreSQL** 
 and
 **Redis**
* Public REST and GraphQL APIs with full access to user data
* AWS Cloud with Kubernetes and Rancher


**Tooling \& Monitoring**
* Internal design system with a React component library
* Vite and Rolldown for build tooling
* DataDog and Sentry for observability
* GitHub, Slack, Plane, Figma, and Whimsical for day\-to\-day work


**Why Join Plane**
* Accelerate your growth. Work alongside senior engineers who genuinely enjoy mentoring and will invest in your development. Code reviews, pairing sessions, and architecture discussions are real learning moments here, not formalities.
* Ship work that matters. The features you build will be used by thousands of teams globally. Youll see the impact of your work in production within weeks of joining — not after months of onboarding.
* Learn the full stack of modern frontend. From local\-first sync to real\-time collaboration to performance at scale, Plane touches nearly every interesting problem in modern frontend engineering. Its a fast way to grow from "I can build features" to "I can design systems."
* Build in the open. Everything you ship lands in an open\-source codebase. Your GitHub contribution graph will reflect the real work youre doing — visible to the community and useful for your career.
* A culture of craft and kindness. We write things down, review each others work carefully, and treat questions — especially from new engineers — as a healthy sign of engagement.
* Room to grow into more. As you mature in the role, youll naturally take on bigger surfaces, more design input, and more ownership. We hire junior engineers expecting them to become senior engineers here.


 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: India City: Hyderabad ,Telangana Company Website: https://plane.so Job Function: Engineering Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Technology Information and Internet

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: AI / ML Internship at Hyderabad
description:
Development Department
Hyderabad • India •
**Overview**
------------


This is a hands\-on, project\-driven internship where you will work directly alongside our ML/AI Engineers and AI Agent Engineers. You will contribute to real deliverables, not just observe, spanning computer vision, multimodal learning, agentic systems, and RAG pipelines.The track you work on is flexible and will be matched to your interests, background, and the team's current priorities. We believe great interns come from many different starting points, curiosity, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn matter more than a perfect resume.By the end of 6 months, you will have worked on production\-adjacent AI systems and built a portfolio of meaningful, demonstrable work


**Skills**
----------

  

  

**Basic Technical Skills (Good to Have, Not All Required)**

* Python basics — ability to write scripts, run notebooks, and understand existing code.
* Familiarity with any ML/DL concept — even from coursework or self\-study counts.
* Exposure to tools like Jupyter, Google Colab, HuggingFace, or OpenAI API.
* Basic understanding of NLP, computer vision, or LLMs — at any depth.
* Comfortable using Git for version control.

**What You Will Work On**


Depending on your track, your day\-to\-day work may include contributions across any of the following areas:

**Vision Track**

* Assist with dataset collection, labeling, and augmentation
* Run and evaluate pre\-trained models (YOLO, ResNet, SAM, CLIP)
* Support model fine\-tuning and performance benchmarking
* Document experiments and results clearly

**Agents Track**

* Write, test, and refine prompts for agent workflows
* Help build and test tool\-calling integrations
* Research and benchmark agent frameworks and orchestrators
* Assist in deploying agents to GPT Store or Copilot Studio

**Multimodal (MLM) Track**

* Explore and test vision\-language models


(LLaVA, BLIP\-2\)

* Prepare multimodal datasets and evaluation sets
* Run inference pipelines and document outputs

**RAG \& Knowledge Track**

* Support document ingestion, chunking, and embedding pipelines
* Test retrieval quality across different vector stores
* Experiment with chunking strategies and re\-ranking methods
* Compare model performance across tasks (VQA, captioning)
* Help evaluate RAG pipeline accuracy and relevance

**Cross\-Track Responsibilities**


Regardless of track, all interns will contribute to:

* Research \& Benchmarking — survey latest models, tools, and papers summarize findings for the team.
* Prompt Writing \& Testing — write, iterate, and evaluate prompts across different LLMs and tasks.
* Model Evaluation \& Testing — run structured evaluations, log results, and identify failure patterns.
* Data Work — collection, cleaning, annotation, and quality checks as needed by the team.
* Documentation — write clear technical notes, how\-to guides, and experiment logs.
* Team Collaboration — participate in standups, sprint planning, and design reviews.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Education**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Electronics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Final\-year students and fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

 **What Matters Most**

* Curiosity — genuine interest in AI and willingness to go deep on problems.
* Logical thinking — ability to break down a problem and think through it step by step.
* Communication — can clearly explain what you tried, what worked, and what did not.
* Initiative — proactively looks for ways to contribute rather than waiting to be told.
* Coachability — open to feedback and fast to apply it.

 **What You Will Gain**

* Real\-world experience building and shipping AI systems — not just toy projects.
* Mentorship from ML/AI Engineers actively working on vision, agents, and multimodal systems.
* A strong portfolio of demonstrable work to show in future job applications.
* Exposure to the full AI product lifecycle — from idea to deployment.
* Certificate of completion and a performance\-based letter of recommendation.
* Potential for a full\-time offer based on performance during the internship.

### **How to Apply**

* Send your resume to: **careers@smartinfologiks.com**
* For queries, call: **\+91\-8080727912**

title: Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: FP&A Lead – Expenses
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.


Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.


That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.


Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.


For our business, for clients, and for you

**About the Company**


Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003 is one of the world’s largest financial service providers with c.13,000 employees operating out of c.85 offices in 42 countries. The Group has c.$3 trillion assets under management and has delivered strong growth of \>10% year on year for the last 3 years. Apex Group offers a single source solution to customers for financial services as it has the broadest range of services amongst its competitors. These services include fund administration solutions, digital on\-boarding of bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, corporate and family office services, business services including HR and payroll and a pioneering ESG ratings and advisory service for private companies.

**Pune Global Service Centre FP\&A Team**


India is growing as an Apex Group finance hub as it provides intelligent, enthusiastic, and energetic professionals to compliment a strong global finance team. This is a great opportunity to join the Global FP\&A Team who have chosen Pune as their FP\&A Global Service Centre (GSC).


The FP\&A Pune Team started with a 7\-member team in 2021 in Phase 1\. Following early successes of the Pune team and the need for increased reporting to stakeholders following a high number of recent business acquisitions, the team grew to 32 members by 2024 in the subsequent hiring phases. We now have a team of technically strong and energetic employees and middle management professionals delivering an increasing number of data sets, standardized deliverables, and improved analytical reporting to assist the Global FP\&A team in managing reporting for the entire portfolio of Group Companies.


The FP\&A organizational structure is relatively flat thereby increasing opportunities for everyone to grow and build a successful career.


We are looking to hire team members who will complement our world class high performing team. These roles are expected to drive data cleansing, standardized processing and be engaging with business, management, and finance teams across the globe.

**The Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Finance professional to join a high performing Global FP\&A team operating in a fast growth Global Financial Services organization.


We have a few openings at Associate, Senior Associate and Assistant Vice President levels.


The Global FP\&A team is functionally structured with Group Reporting (which includes synergy reporting as well), Revenue, People Cost and Other Expense Reporting and Partnering as the main pillars who also play a major role in stake holder partnership and management. The Entire Team and each Pillar is led by extremely knowledgeable, experienced, dedicated, and professional leaders.


Basis the specific function the activities may differ, but an overall list of activities covered under the various roles are as below:

* Close partnership with the FP\&A Regional Finance, Business Leads and Cost Centre Owners

description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

 **Job Description/Position Title: IT Project Manager, PMO Transformation Office**

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Type:** FTE

**Reports To:** IT Program Manager

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and evolve the enterprise PMO strategy and operating model aligned to business goals in alignment with the Global GTO PMO Office.
* Act as a change agent, championing project and portfolio discipline while promoting agility and innovation.
* Lead a team of program and project managers to deliver strategic initiatives on time, on budget, and on Business Value.

**Portfolio \& Program Management**

* Oversee intake, planning, execution, and tracking of programs and large\-scale initiatives.
* Manage enterprise\-wide project portfolio ensuring alignment to strategic priorities and resource capacity.
* Implement value realization practices to track benefits, ROI, and business impact.

**Governance \& Standards**

* Establish and enforce project management frameworks, templates, and best practices.
* Own executive\-level portfolio reporting and provide insights to senior leadership for Local PMO delivery, mapping up to Global delivery, metrics, standards.
* Ensure risk management, financial tracking, and milestone governance across the portfolio.

**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Act as a strategic advisor to executive sponsors and stakeholders on delivery health and tradeoffs.
* Foster strong cross\-functional collaboration with Technology, Finance, HR, and Business Units.
* Lead quarterly portfolio reviews and partner in AOP planning and investment prioritization.

**Team Development \& Leadership**

* Build, mentor, and inspire a high\-performing team of PMO professionals.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, business value orientation, and performance excellence.
* Champion learning, development, and career growth for PMO team members.

 **What We’re Looking For:**

* **Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in project/program management, with at least 5 years leading a PMO or enterprise portfolio function.
* Demonstrated success managing large, cross\-functional technology and business programs.
* Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid) and portfolio tools (e.g., Project Online, Clarity, Smartsheet, Jira, Cognos, Anaplan).
* Experience with benefit realization frameworks, financial governance, and KPI tracking.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification required; Agile or SAFe certifications a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or related advanced degree preferred.
* **What You’ll Bring**
* Strategic mindset with strong operational rigor.
* Ability to influence and collaborate at all levels, from project teams to executive leadership.
* Passion for driving business outcomes—not just project deliverables.
* An inclusive and empowering leadership style that inspires high performance.

  

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  

  

**How We Work:**  

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**  

We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

**Who We Are:**  

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.


Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.


Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.  

  

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.

The Culture at Mattel

title: Workday Recruiting Consultant(F/M/X)
description:
Job description
  
  

Join our team as a Workday Recruiting Consultant and contribute to the successful implementation and support of Workday Recruiting solutions for our partners. This role involves coordinating and contributing to all phases of the project lifecycle, from planning to deployment.
  
  

Your missions
  
Collaborate in the project framework, including planning, organization, and governance setup
  
Conduct workshops to identify and specify recruitment requirements
  
Configure and maintain Workday Recruiting processes such as job requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview scheduling, and offer management
  
Monitor and follow up on the progress of configurations
  
Define and execute testing scenarios to validate recruiting solutions
  
Support deployment and provide user assistance during the transition
  
Deliver training sessions to end users and support change management initiatives
  
Collaborate with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to optimize recruiting workflows
  
  

Your profile
  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Engineering, or a related field
  
Previous experience in Workday Recruiting projects, including implementation, support, or enhancements
  
Hands\-on experience in configuring Workday Recruiting module
  
Strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle and business processes
  
Familiarity with integrations such as job boards, career sites, and third\-party vendors is a plus
  
Workday Recruiting certification is preferred
  
Strong communication skills with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders
  
Dynamic, proactive, and solution\-oriented mindset
  
Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus
  
  

What we offer
  
  

An international community bringing together 110\+ nationalities.
  
**An environment where trust has a central place:** 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
  
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250\+ available modules.
  
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.).
  
Strong commitments to CSR notably through participation in our WeCare Together program.
  
  

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.
  
  

Who are we?
  
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  
  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  
  

**Brief Call:** Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  
  

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  
  

**Case study:** Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc.
  
  

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  
We look forward to meeting you!

### **Position Summary:**



The **Security Officer** acts as the operational lead at the site level, responsible for implementing security procedures, supervising guard personnel, coordinating with clients, and ensuring all security and safety standards are consistently met. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.

  



### **Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Site Command and Control:**


* Function as the second\-in\-command or site head (depending on site size).
  


* Lead and monitor all security operations at the designated client site.
  


* Ensure guards follow all post duties, site\-specific instructions (SSIs), and G4S protocols.
  



**2\. Team Supervision:**


* Supervise the deployment and performance of Security Supervisors and Guards.
  


* Conduct daily muster, uniform inspection, and tool checks.
  


* Address absenteeism, disciplinary issues, and performance shortfalls.
  



**3\. Client Coordination:**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client at the site.
  


* Conduct regular meetings with client representatives to address concerns or updates.
  


* Ensure client satisfaction through prompt issue resolution and quality service delivery.
  



**4\. Operational Execution:**


* Ensure access control systems, patrolling routines, visitor management, and asset protection are functioning as per SOP.
  


* Monitor surveillance systems and review CCTV footage in coordination with client security teams.
  


* Supervise material movement, vehicle access, and contractor/staff entry protocols.
  



**5\. Incident Management:**


* Act promptly in case of incidents like theft, fire, medical emergencies, or safety violations.
  


* Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
  


* File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.
  



**6\. Documentation \& Reporting:**


* Maintain daily shift logs, occurrence reports, visitor data, and material movement records.
  


* Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
  


* Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit\-ready.
  



**7\. Training \& Compliance:**


* Conduct on\-the\-job training, drills, and refreshers for site guards.
  


* Ensure adherence to G4S grooming, behavior, and discipline standards.
  


* Support HR and compliance teams during audits, inspections, or client reviews.

  



### **Eligibility Criteria:**


* **Education:** Minimum 12th Pass; Graduate preferred.
  


* **Experience:**  



	+ 4–8 years of experience in the security industry, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or officer\-level role.
	  
	
	
	+ Background in defence/police/paramilitary preferred.
* **Age:** 28 to 50 years (Flexible for ex\-servicemen).
  


* **Physical Standards:** Fit and alert; Minimum height 170 cm.

  



### **Key Skills \& Attributes:**


* Strong leadership and coordination skills.
  


* Good written and verbal communication (English, Hindi, and local language).
  


* Proficiency in report writing, basic computer use (MS Office, email).
  


* Knowledge of safety procedures, emergency protocols, and fire prevention.
  


* Ability to handle pressure and work rotational shifts.

  



### **Working Conditions:**


* Site\-based duty with 8/12\-hour shifts depending on deployment.
  


* 6\-day work week or rotational off, as per duty schedule.
  


* Uniform, mobile phone (if applicable), ID card, and duty gear provided.

### **Remuneration:**


* As per G4S internal grade structure and prevailing **Minimum Wages for Security Officer/Supervisor category** in the respective state/UT.

With a focus on technology driven solutions and deep insight in the publishing domain, Springer Nature Technology and Publishing Solutions offers a range of services that help our Group brand acquire, produce and deliver content in the most efficient ways possible. We are driven by over 1000 professionals in Technology, Research \& Analysis and Marketing shared services.


**About the Role**

The **Senior Workday Core HCM Specialist** will be the lead subject matter expert for Workday Core HCM with a primary focus on **process optimization, data quality and validation, and automated document generation** . This role will own existing end\-to\-end Workday HCM processes, design and enforce data validation frameworks, drive continuous process improvements, and deliver high\-quality operational documentation and generated outputs (offer letters, contracts, reports). The specialist will partner closely with HR, Payroll, IT, vendors and downstream system owners to ensure Workday is configured and operated to deliver accurate, auditable, and scalable HR services.


**Responsibilities** :


* **Workday Core HCM Ownership** — Lead design, configuration and maintenance of Core HR (Employee Lifecycle) business processes to enhance data accuracy and useability
* **Process Optimization** — Map current\-state processes, identify inefficiencies, design streamlined Workday\-driven processes, and implement automation (including document generation) to reduce manual work and error rates.
* **Data Quality and Validation** — Define and implement data governance rules, validation checks, reconciliation routines and exception handling across Workday and downstream systems.
* **Document Generation and Templates** — Design, build and maintain document generation templates and automated outputs (e.g., offer letters, employment contracts, HR reports) ensuring consistency, compliance and localization where required.
* **Reporting and Analytics** — Create advanced Workday reports and dashboards that surface data quality metrics, process KPIs and audit trails; use calculated fields and transformations to support validation logic.
* **Testing and Release Management** — Lead end\-to\-end testing for configuration changes, business process updates and Workday releases; manage change control and rollback plans.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration** — Act as the primary liaison between HR functional sponsors, IT, vendors and external partners to translate business requirements into robust system specifications.
* **Operational Excellence** — Maintain runbooks, SOPs and documentation for processes, validations and generated documents; coach and upskill HR operations teams on best practices.
* **Continuous Improvement** — Monitor Workday release notes, evaluate new features for process enablement, and drive adoption of enhancements that improve data integrity and automation.

**Experience, Skills \& Qualifications** :


* **Proven Workday expertise** : Extensive hands\-on experience with Workday Core HCM configuration, business process framework, complex calculated fields, and report writing.
* **Data governance experience** : Demonstrable track record implementing data validation frameworks, reconciliation processes and data remediation programs.
* **Document generation skills** : Experience building and maintaining automated document templates and generation processes within Workday or integrated document engines.
* **Technical fluency** : Strong understanding of Workday business object model, integrations concepts, and ability to collaborate with integration engineers and vendors.
* **Analytical and testing capability** : Advanced analytical skills with experience designing test plans, UAT, regression testing and documenting results.
* **Communication and leadership** : Excellent stakeholder management, presentation and written communication skills; ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues.
* **Education and experience** : Bachelor’s degree in HR, IT, Computer Science or related field preferred; 5\+ years Workday Core HCM experience with progressive responsibility.

**Behaviours and Values**

* **Customer focused** — prioritizes HR and employee experience while balancing technical constraints.
* **Detail oriented** — rigorous about data accuracy, auditability and compliance.
* **Proactive problem solver** — anticipates issues and drives pragmatic solutions.
* **Collaborative** — builds strong partnerships across HR, IT and vendor teams.
* **Inclusive** — supports Springer Nature’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

SN\-Ability to Assess People , SN\-Action\-Oriented , SN\-Balances Stakeholder , SN\-Being Resilient , SN\-Case Management , SN\-Communicates Effectively , SN\-Consulting Skills , SN\-Data analytics / Quantitative Skills , SN\-Persuasion , SN\-Self\-Awareness

At Springer Nature, we value the diversity of our teams and work to build an inclusive culture, where people are treated fairly and can bring their differences to work and thrive. Alupuram Works produces and sells over 12000 TPA of Aluminium extrusions.

This factory located in a semi\-urban area and value of the land and other assets comes around Rs.600 Crores. There is potential for theft and encroachment of land in case of any security lapse.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

In Kerala the labour laws are very stringent and company should ensure to provide all welfare facilities to its employees. Presently there are 430 permanent employees and 85 Contractors¿ workmen working inside the factory. Liaise with Labour department and other Governmental departments are very essential to be in good relations. Employee relations in an environment of strong trade unionism with political back up need more attention.  

  

Company initiates CSR activities in the villages surrounding the plant, which have a population of 35000, and total area will be 12 sq. kilometers. Major CSR activities include support to Education, Woman empowerment for Sustainable development and Infrastructure facilities and Health care programmes. Liaise with Local bodies and NGOs are essential for mobilizing funds from various Govt. schemes and implementing these activities effectively.

Trade unions are very aggressive and liaise with unions need special attention to facilitate the negotiation and implementation of any expansion project proposals.  

  

  

  

  

Contractors¿ workmen carry out company insourced and outsourced jobs. A good number of them are migrant laborers from different parts of the country and the background of those workmen is unknown. In the context of terrorist attacks at various places, more vigilance is required and hence the whereabouts of these workmen are checked to prevent any untoward incidents.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.
  
  

Who are we?
  
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  
  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  
  

**Brief Call:** Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  
  

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  
  

**Case study:** Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc.
  
  

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  
We look forward to meeting you!
