* Accountable for the application configuration and its associated governance
* Oversee the high\-level solution delivery of the application/system.
* Quality assurance for all the documentation related to the specific solution/system landscape.
* Detailed and credible estimation of high level and detail task\-based elements of the project plan depending on the stage of the project.
* Identify the Continuous improvement opportunities in the solution landscape.
* Responsible for support SLA and service delivery of related applications
* Actively participate in the business change review, prioritisation \& management process
* Understand the impact of the change (big or small) and sign off the right solution.
* Contribute to the release \& change management forums where is needed (CRB, TAB \& CAB)
* Understand the Pentland customer centric service management framework.
* Responsible for delivering against the agreed BSLA in the respective area.

**What you'll need to thrive:**

* Excellent technical knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors (SAP SF), especially on Employee Central, Performance \& Goals, Recruitment \& Onboarding and EC Payroll modules.
* Strong HRIS knowledge and a sound understanding of HR processes and their impact on other areas of the organization.
* A good technical knowledge of associated applications \& solutions specific to the area of responsibility (Integrations and API’s)
* Pro\-active in approach and keen to suggest new and innovative solutions.
* Able to lead \& work with ambiguity and flexible to accommodate multiple changes in priority.
* Ability to manage stakeholders at all levels with exceptional communication and networking skills.
* Ability to provide detailed resource planning for a global team across many projects and applications.
* Ability to work with Project managers and plan projects in line with task being defined and resource capability.
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, including ability to conduct formal and informal presentations and workshops with the ability to communicate across all levels of the business.
* Exceptionally well organised and able to prioritise, communicate and manage expectations with various levels of stakeholders.
* Committed to having a continuous improvement mind\-set that spans people, processes, technologies, and own self.
* Able to work independently, with a confident, assertive and customer focused outlook.
* Able to deliver quality work and to commit to and meet deadlines.
* Able to demonstrate positive attitude \- go the extra mile, committed, willing to take on challenges and has a can\-do mind\-set.
* Able to demonstrate energy, drive, enthusiasm, determination, and passion.


Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident \& term life insurance cover.

**The Interview Process**


We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Talent Team Intro Call** \- A 30\-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
* **Experience Interview** \- A more in\-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
* **In\-Person Interview** \- An in\-person meeting at our office to continue the conversation from your experience interview. This stage may also include discussion of any task or preparation shared in advance.
* **Final Interview** \- A final in\-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

title: Specialist - Talent sourcing

Through asking the right questions to ensure a detailed understanding of the client and each role, and by leveraging data, historic hiring trends, and market analysis, Talent Sourcers develop bespoke sourcing strategies and then use a range of tools and techniques to find the best talent in the market. description:
**About Aptia**

Founded to shape the future of pensions, health, and insurance solutions, Aptia is a leading professional services firm dedicated to simplifying complexity for businesses and individuals. We bring together cutting\-edge technology and deep industry expertise to help organisations navigate an evolving landscape with clarity and confidence.


With a presence in the US, UK, India, and Portugal, we support over six million people and more than 1,100 clients, delivering solutions that drive efficiency, enhance financial security, and provide peace of mind.


Our strength lies in the combination of smart technology and expert teams, ensuring that managing pensions, health, and insurance is more effective. By focusing on innovation, accessibility, and client success, we help businesses take care of their people, so they can focus on what they do best.


And we are expanding. Aptia Group is not only fueled by our investors' backing but also by our commitment to foster the growth and success of our people. At Aptia, we're investing heavily in learning and development, paving unique career paths for our colleagues.


Specialist. Responsive. Thoughtful. Our values aren't just words; they are the backbone of our business. Our team embodies our values daily, to surpass client expectations, evolve constantly and nurture genuine relationships for the long\-term.


**Job requirements**

**Job Title:** Pensions Administration Domain Trainer
  

**Location:** India (Hybrid / On\-site)
  

**Experience:** 3–6 Years
  

**Department:** Learning \& Talent
  

**Reporting to:** Lead – Pensions Training Academy


**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Pensions Domain Trainer to independently deliver high\-quality training for our UK pensions administration team. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in pensions operations, strong facilitation skills, and the ability to simplify technical topics for new joiners and colleagues who want to upskill or go for a relevant certification.


While initial onboarding and guidance will be provided, the candidate is expected to independently manage the end\-to\-end training lifecycle—including facilitation, learner engagement, Q\&A sessions, and training administration—within a few weeks of joining.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Training Delivery**

* Deliver structured training programs on UK pensions administration processes for new joiners and upskilling programs for existing employees.
* Facilitate virtual and/or classroom sessions covering pensions operations (joiners, leavers, retirements, transfers, etc.) with clarity and impact.
* Conduct Q\&A sessions and reinforcement sessions using practical examples from real cases.
* Stay updated on UK pension regulations and changes and reflect them in learning sessions where applicable.

**Training Administration \& Coordination**

* Manage training logistics including session scheduling, attendance tracking, learner assessments, and certification preparation coordination.
* Collaborate with senior trainers and content developers to enhance training materials based on delivery experience.
* Report training delivery status, learner progress, assessment scores, and key observations to the relevant stakeholders; flag any risks or support needed proactively.
* Collect feedback and share suggestions for improvement with the L\&D team.
* Maintain training documentation, FAQs, and session\-wise trackers.

**Content Development \& SME Support**

* Provide **subject matter expertise (SME)** to instructional designers and learning developers for the creation of high\-quality **e\-learning modules and other digital assets** for the Pensions domain learning.
* Review the learning content to ensure technical accuracy, relevance, completeness, and alignment with latest UK pensions regulations.
* Offer insights and updates to support the continuous improvement of the learning material.

**Must\-have Training Skills**

To be successful in this role, the following facilitation competencies are essential:


* **Clarity of Communication** : Ability to explain technical and regulatory concepts in simple, understandable language.
* **Voice Modulation \& Pacing** : Effective verbal delivery with variation in tone, pitch, and pace to maintain interest.
* **Command over English Language** : Clear articulation, correct grammar usage, and professional vocabulary to ensure credibility and learner comprehension across UK\-based processes.
* **Learner Engagement** : Use of questioning techniques, examples, scenarios, and digital tools to keep sessions interactive.
* **Confidence \& Preparation** : Thorough command over session content, with readiness to address learner questions independently.
* **Responsiveness \& Patience** : Addressing queries professionally while encouraging participation across knowledge levels.
* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, seeking better ways to enhance learning and delivery.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in UK pensions administration or a closely related process.
* Comfort with virtual platforms (Teams/Zoom) and basic presentation tools (PPT, whiteboard tools).
* Strong organizational skills for managing batch\-wise logistics, learner data, and follow\-ups.
* High accountability for independent training delivery after initial support phase.
* Pensions Administration domain experience is a must.

**Good\-to\-Have**

* Exposure to CPC or APE content or certification (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience coordinating or contributing to training content development.
* Familiarity with LMS tools or digital learning platforms.

**Who can apply?**

This role is not limited to colleagues who are already working in training or learning teams within pensions or benefits administration organisations.


We are equally open to experienced pensions administrators who are currently working in the business or operations side and are interested in pivoting into a training role and building a career in learning. What is non\-negotiable is **deep expertise in pensions administration, a strong understanding of the regulatory environment, pensions rules, and the ability to work through and explain complex calculation scenarios and cases** .


Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, simple way are essential. Prior, in\-depth training experience is not a requirement.


In this role, you will combine your pensions expertise with the support of a learning and talent team that brings deep experience in designing high\-quality learning solutions, using modern learning methodologies, digital formats, and learning technology.


Aptia is doing exciting work in building skills and capability across the organisation, and this role offers the opportunity to be part of that journey while developing a new dimension of your career.


**How to apply**

If you are interested in this role, then we’d love to hear from you. Please go ahead and click apply and submit your resume with appropriate contact information.


Aptia is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable work environment. At Aptia, fostering an equitable and inclusive environment for all our people to flourish is a priority. We are an equal opportunity employer and aim to attract and retain the best people without attention to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, political affiliation, race, religion, gender and sexual orientation.  



  

If there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process to ensure it is accessible to you, we encourage you to reach out to us.

Hands\-on experience in creating or managing **HR systems, tracking tools, and performance frameworks** for field agents.

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.
Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.
Bechtel’s India offices support the execution of projects and services around the world. Working seamlessly with Bechtel’s global business units, project sites, customers, and suppliers, our teams have delivered more than 125 projects since 1994\. With offices in Gurgaon, Vadodara, and Chennai there are exciting career opportunities for candidates who are passionate about delivering projects that make a lasting, meaningful difference for people and communities around the world.

**Job Summary:**
----------------


In this role, you will support contingent workforce operations by managing work orders, payroll\-related processes, and vendor coordination activities. You will be responsible for ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and timely processing across systems while partnering cross\-functionally with internal teams and external suppliers. This position requires strong problem\-solving skills, the ability to manage high\-volume work in a fast\-paced environment, and a proactive approach to research and process improvement.
This position is designated as part\-time telework per our global telework policy and may require at least three days of in\-person attendance per week at the assigned office or project. Weekly in\-person schedules will be determined by the individual and their supervisor, in consultation with functional or project leadership.**Major Responsibilities:**
---------------------------

**Create \& Manage Job Postings:** Develop job posting templates, assist hiring managers, and ensure alignment with job classifications and job keys.  

**Work Order Processing:** Create, review, and revise work orders for data accuracy, pay rates, assignment updates, and compliance with staffing agreements.  

**Onboarding \& Reporting:** Manage first\-day reporting instructions, badging paperwork, and provide required information to staffing agencies and projects.  

**Personnel Monitoring \& Compliance:** Track personnel assignments, ensure timely processing of assignment extensions and policy compliance.  

**Agency Conversions \& Release Notifications:** Coordinate conversions of agency staff to Bechtel and handle release notifications and work order deactivations.  

**Fieldglass System \& Vendor Management:** Use Fieldglass software to troubleshoot issues, support system processes, and recommend improvements.  

**Data Collection \& Reporting:** Collect, analyze, and assemble data for personnel reports, payroll processing, timekeeping, and expense management.  

**Payroll \& Financial Support:** Support payroll\-related activities, validate financial data, and ensure alignment with finance processes and controls.  

**Account Reconciliation:** Perform reconciliation of records across systems to ensure accuracy of payroll, invoicing, and financial data.  

**Audit \& Compliance:** Support audit activities by ensuring documentation accuracy, compliance with policies, and readiness for internal/external reviews.  

**Vendor Relations \& Supplier Onboarding:** Build relationships with vendors, assist with onboarding, contract coordination, and system setup for suppliers.  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and project teams to resolve issues and ensure seamless operations.  

**Training \& Continuous Improvement:** Train team members on PMO standards, document processes, and support continuous improvement initiatives.  

**Research \& Problem Solving:** Conduct research to resolve issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions in a non\-repetitive, dynamic environment.

**Education and Experience Requirements:**
------------------------------------------


Bachelor's degree in HR, Finance, Accounting, or related field. In lieu of degree, position requires minimum two (2\) years work experience in an administrative or HR processing role and two (2\) to eight (8\) years' experience in payroll processing, finance, or related field.
Experience and familiarity with payroll processing in SAP, Oracle, Fieldglass, or other ERP systems.

**Required Knowledge and Skills:**
----------------------------------

* Strong background in **payroll and finance processes**, including data validation and reconciliation
* Experience supporting **audit activities** and maintaining compliance with policies and procedures
* Strong **technical aptitude** with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Fieldglass
* Ability to perform **research**, analyze issues, and identify solutions independently
* Proven ability to work in a **fast\-paced, high\-volume environment** with shifting priorities
* Strong **problem\-solving skills** with attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage **non\-repetitive work** and adapt to changing tasks and priorities
* Strong ability to **take detailed notes**, document processes, and apply findings
* Ability to **switch gears quickly** and manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Experience with **account reconciliation** and data validation across systems
* Strong **cross\-functional collaboration** skills with the ability to partner effectively across teams
* Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills

-----------------------

GP Strategies is a global leader in talent transformation , dedicated to empowering organizations to unlock their full potential. We help businesses enhance workforce performance and achieve strategic goals through innovative, technology\-enabled learning solutions. With a proven track record of supporting over 6,000 global organizations worldwide, we combine human expertise with AI\-driven insights to deliver customized strategies that upskill talent, drive technology adoption, and
  

optimize critical processes. Our mission is to create a lasting impact by equipping organizations with the strategy, skills, and tools needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.


**Role Purpose**
----------------

The HR Generalist plays a critical role in delivering efficient and compliant HR Operations support across key functional areas, including payroll, statutory compliance, employee life cycle management, and employee services.


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

**HR Operations \& Payroll Support**

* Provide day\-to\-day HR Operations support covering payroll administration, compensation inputs, onboarding, employee relations support, and employee exit processes.
* Liaise with payroll service providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing in line with defined calendars and compliance requirements.
* Validate payroll inputs, perform quality checks, and support resolution of payroll\-related discrepancies.

**Time Office \& Attendance Management**

* Monitor and audit time office and absence management reports through the HCM system.
* Ensure timely closure of attendance data and coordinate with stakeholders to address exceptions or data gaps.

**Statutory Compliance \& Administration**

* Support timely statutory administration, including PF and ESI enrolments, exits, claims, and portal updates.
* Maintain statutory records, registers, returns, and documentation to ensure ongoing compliance.
* Coordinate statutory benefit closures and support full and final settlement activities for exiting employees.

**Employee Life Cycle Management**

* Process employee data for joiners, movers, and leavers, ensuring accuracy across all HR systems.
* Provide operational support from onboarding through exit, collaborating with HR lifecycle teams as required.

**HR Systems \& Data Management**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee data in HRIS and relevant databases.
* Audit employee records and documentation to ensure data integrity, completeness, and compliance.

**Employee Services \& Stakeholder Support**

* Manage HR helpdesk queries related to payroll, benefits, insurance enrolments, statutory deductions, and HR processes.
* Provide clear guidance to employees and internal stakeholders on HR policies, processes, and timelines.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Payroll and statutory activities are executed accurately, on time, and with zero compliance issues.
* Employee records and HR data are complete, accurate, and audit\-ready at all times.
* Internal stakeholders receive timely, clear, and solution\-oriented HR support.
* Employees experience consistent, responsive, and professional HR services throughout their lifecycle.
* HR operational processes demonstrate continuous improvement and efficiency.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------

### **Experience \& Capability**

* Demonstrated capability in HR Operations and Generalist responsibilities across payroll, statutory compliance, and employee life cycle management.
* Experience working closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors in a service\-oriented HR environment.

### **Technical Strength**

* Working knowledge of statutory frameworks and portals (e.g., PF, ESI).
* Experience using HRIS/ERP systems; exposure to Oracle\-based systems is an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in MS Office tools, particularly Excel, for reporting and data validation.

### **Mindset \& OneGP Behaviours**

* Demonstrates accountability, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality outcomes.
* Collaborates effectively across teams and builds strong working relationships.
* Operates with integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism in handling sensitive employee data.
* Shows a continuous improvement mindset and adaptability in a dynamic, global environment.

**Why Join GP Strategies**
--------------------------

This role offers the opportunity to be part of a global HR team, supporting diverse employee populations and contributing to impactful people processes. At GP Strategies, you will work in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values innovation, continuous learning, and strong partnerships—empowering you to make a meaningful contribution to both employee experience and business success.

description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented HR Executive to manage end\-to\-end HR operations across multiple sites (toll plazas, parking locations, etc.). The role involves payroll processing, attendance management, compliance, and employee coordination across different locations.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Payroll \& Salary Management**

* Prepare and process monthly salaries for employees across multiple sites
* Calculate wages, overtime, deductions, advances, and bonuses
* Maintain salary sheets site\-wise and ensure accuracy
* Handle statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, TDS, etc.)
* Coordinate with accounts team for salary disbursement

**2\. Attendance \& Workforce Tracking**

* Maintain daily attendance records for all sites
* Coordinate with site supervisors for attendance and shift data
* Track absenteeism, leaves, and overtime

**3\. Compliance \& Documentation**

* Ensure compliance with labour laws and statutory requirements
* Maintain employee records, contracts, and documentation
* Handle PF, ESIC registrations and filings
* Assist in audits and inspections

**4\. Recruitment \& Onboarding**

* Support hiring for site\-level staff (operators, supervisors, etc.)
* Conduct basic screening and coordinate interviews
* Manage joining formalities and documentation

**5\. Employee Coordination**

* Act as a point of contact between site staff and management
* Handle employee queries related to salary, attendance, and policies
* Resolve basic HR issues and escalate when required

**6\. Reporting \& MIS**

* Prepare monthly HR reports (salary, attendance, manpower status)
* Maintain site\-wise employee database
* Generate reports for management review

**Skills \& Requirements**

* Experience: 1–4 years in HR/payroll (preferably multi\-location operations)
* Strong knowledge of payroll processing and labour laws
* Good command of Excel (very important for salary sheets)
* Ability to manage data for multiple sites simultaneously
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy

Job Type: Permanent

Pay: From ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Trainee Research Associate
description:
**Trainee Research Associate**  **C0010(Freshers Only, Remote)**

**Research NXT / Bamboo Reports**

**Location:** Remote \| **Type:** Full\-time, Fresher \| **Compensation:** ₹2,40,000 – ₹2,60,000 per year

**About Research NXT and Bamboo Reports**

Research NXT is a 10\-year\-old research and intelligence company based in India. We help B2B technology companies understand their markets. When a software company wants to know which businesses to sell to, which decision\-makers to reach, and how their competitors are positioned, they come to us. Our analysts do the digging, structure the findings, and deliver intelligence that drives real business decisions.

Bamboo Reports is our flagship platform, built over three years by our own team. It is used by global technology vendors, consulting firms, and investors to plan their India strategy.

We are a small, analyst\-led team. Bootstrapped. Profitable since day one. In 2025, we rebuilt our entire platform using AI\-assisted development, and AI now runs across our research workflow. We are hiring our next batch of Research Associates who will learn the craft of intelligence work, and grow with us as we scale.

*Rated* ***4\.4 on Glassdoor*** *and* ***4\.1 on Google*** *by our current and former team members. Check for yourself before you apply.*

**Who We Are Looking For**

We want curious, sharp\-eyed freshers who love finding things on the internet. If you have ever gone down a Wikipedia rabbit hole for three hours, spent a weekend researching which laptop to buy, or pieced together information from LinkedIn, company websites, and news articles to understand a company, you might be our kind of person.

This role is about:

* Secondary research across the open web, company websites, LinkedIn, financial reports, and industry sources
* Reading between the lines of what companies say to find what they actually do
* Structuring messy information into clean, usable datasets
* Learning how to use AI tools to do research faster, sharper, and at scale

You will not write code. You will not build models. But you will work alongside AI every single day, because that is how modern research is done. The future of research belongs to analysts who know how to use AI well. We will teach you.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most entry\-level research jobs have you filling spreadsheets all day. This one is different.

You will work on intelligence that real B2B companies pay for. Your work shows up in dashboards used by decision\-makers at technology vendors, consulting firms, and global enterprises. You will learn:

* How AI is changing the research profession, and how to stay ahead of it
* How to structure data like a product, not just a report
* How B2B companies use intelligence to make real decisions
* What good analytical thinking looks like, from analysts who have been doing this for two decades

**Where This Role Can Take You**

A Trainee Research Associate role at Research NXT is not a stop\-gap job. It is the start of a career in intelligence.

**Several of the people who joined us as Trainee Research Associates three to four years ago are today Managers leading platform development and research at Bamboo Reports.** They shape what gets built, how it gets built, and how we deliver intelligence to clients. That is the path we open for people who take the craft seriously.

If you are looking for a place where your work compounds, where you are trusted with real responsibility early, and where growing with the company is the norm rather than the exception, you will find it here.

**Apply Only If**

* You have your own laptop or PC at home with power backup
* You have a minimum 50 Mbps broadband connection and a quiet space to work
* You are comfortable reading and writing in English
* You know your way around MS Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* You can search the internet like a detective, not just a casual user

**What You Get**

* Monthly performance incentives
* Work\-from\-home setup
* One\-month paid on\-the\-job training with a stipend
* Training completion bonus and certificate on successful completion
* Internet reimbursement
* Corporate health insurance
* Paid sick leave, paid time off, leave encashment
* Direct mentorship from the founder and senior analysts
* Real exposure to AI tools that working analysts use every day

**Selection Process**

**Round 1: System Check (10 minutes).** Shortlisted candidates receive an email with instructions to confirm their setup.

**Round 2: Research Assignment (1 day).** We give you a short basic training, followed by a data assignment. This tells us how you think, not just what you know.

**Round 3: Technical and Personal Interview.** A conversation about your assignment, your curiosity, and how you approach problems.

Selected candidates begin a one\-month paid on\-the\-job training.

**Application Questions**

* Do you have your own laptop or PC with reliable power backup?
* Do you have an internet connection with a speed of 50 Mbps or higher?
* How would you rate your proficiency in MS Excel? (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced)
* In two or three sentences, tell us about one topic you researched on your own in the last six months, and what you found.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹260,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: T&T- Customer Strategy & Design-Senior Consultant-TMT | Delhi
description:
Job requisition ID :: 102858
Date: Apr 20, 2026
Location: Delhi
Designation: Senior Consultant
Entity: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP
**Job Responsibilities:**



We are looking for a Consultant/Senior Consultant/Manager for Customer Strategy and Applied design focused on Strategy \& Operations. The role involves responsibility for leading a discrete work stream or module on a large\-scale project or overall delivery lead in case of short term/ small scale engagement. The key focus sectors would be TMT organizations.



For instance, on a Strategy project for a telecommunication company, focused on recommending strategies for revenue uplift – involving market assessment, conducting primary/ secondary research, analyzing competitor landscape, strategies, pricing models and market share, deep dive analysis on selected KPIs, data analytics, building a financial model to estimate potential revenue and costs under different scenarios, identify key regulatory considerations and partnership opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategy and presenting findings/ recommendations to the client’s leadership teams. The extent of analysis, hands\-on implementation expected varies from case to case, and depends on the size of the team and scope of the project.



The responsibilities can include:


* Build and maintain a solid understanding of the client's business objectives and processes to become a trusted advisor for all issues related to business strategy, operations, performance, revenue generation and cost optimization.
* Develop/define \& implement strategic programs to enhance business penetration \& increase revenues for the client, or rationalize costs.
* Identify and make recommendations for actions to improve business performance and drive incremental revenue.
* Working with internal teams, and clients to develop and implement long term and short term engagement objectives and work plan
* Thinking through a solution lens and working with client and Deloitte’s teams to deliver engagements


* Leading small client and internal teams to understand, design, enhance, confirm and deliver objectives of the engagement


* Working in alignment with the internal and client team to ensure a streamlined delivery model with seamless integration of the final deliverable across modules
* Communicating, analysis, recommendations and status updates in both written and oral communication with internal and client leadership
* Report writing and preparation of final deliverable
* Assisting seniors in responding to client requests, RFPs and problem statements with proposals
* Building the relationship between Deloitte and the client’s project team


**Job Qualifications:**



Successful candidates will have a degree from a top\-tier MBA, Engineering, BBA or B.Com. Program, 3\+years (C),5\+years (SC) , 8\+yrs (M) of relevant business experience, and the ability to meet each of the following criteria:


* An entry level (C) or expert level of knowledge (SC or M) in telecom business, operating model, product \& pricing strategies, marketing, sales\-distribution, and data analysis techniques
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting specially in thinking through large andcomplex engagements
* Background or experience (through coursework or employment) in TMT organization (optional for freshers)
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Leadership qualities, project management skills, and the ability to mentor
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* Candidates from all academic backgrounds are encouraged to apply


* Willingness for long term international or domestic travel



Personal Qualities Valued:


* Passionate in participating and working on complex engagements and opportunities
* Intellectually powerful and agile: curious, rigorous, and creative
* Emotionally intelligent: high ability to build strong relationships that inspire openness and trust; to collaborate in teamwork settings with colleagues and clients; and to balance inquiry and advocacy in all personal interactions
* Comfortable with working on difficult issues where there can be no definitive “right” answer; patient in the face of uncertainty, complexity and ambiguity
* Capable of working on multiple, overlapping tasks in a fast\-paced environment
* Able to take initiative and make things happen with moderate supervision and guidance

description:
Ncore Builders is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented Civil Draftsman to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate technical drawings and plans for construction and interior projects. Both freshers and experienced candidates are encouraged to apply.

**LOCATION : PAYYANNUR**

**Working Drawing Preparation:**

* Prepare detailed working drawings for the entire project, including plans, elevations, sections, and construction details.
* Ensure all drawings are dimensionally accurate, reflect the design intent, and meet project specifications.
* Review design documents for compliance with building codes, standards, and regulations.

**Detailed Section Drawings:**

* Produce detailed section drawings that represent vertical cut\-throughs of the building to illustrate internal construction, material layers, and structural details.
* Focus on areas requiring in\-depth analysis, such as foundations, walls, floors, and roof connections.

**Detailed Elevation Drawings:**

* Prepare clear, scaled elevation drawings of all building facades, showing exterior details such as windows, doors, and architectural features.
* Specify materials, finishes, and surface treatments for the building’s exterior elements.

**Electrical Detailing:**

* Create detailed electrical drawings, including the layout of circuits, outlets, lighting fixtures, panel locations, and wiring connections.
* Work closely with electrical engineers to ensure the electrical system is properly integrated into the building design.

**Plumbing Detailing:**

* Develop plumbing drawings that include the layout of pipes, drains, water supply, fixtures, and valves.
* Provide details on plumbing connections, materials, and specifications to ensure the system meets code requirements and is operational.

**Tiles Laying Detailing:**

* Create detailed drawings for tile layouts in bathrooms, kitchens, floors, and other areas.
* Specify tile types, grout lines, installation patterns, and material finishes.
* Coordinate with contractors to ensure proper tile installation procedures are followed.

**Landscape Detailing:**

* Prepare detailed landscaping drawings that include plant layouts, irrigation systems, pathways, and outdoor structures.
* Detail features like lighting, fencing, and surface materials, ensuring they align with the overall architectural design.

**Compound Wall Detailing:**

* Provide drawings detailing the design and construction of compound walls, including foundation, material selection, and structural components.
* Ensure wall details are in compliance with safety standards and functional requirements.

**Structural Detailing:**

* Develop structural drawings that detail the design and construction of elements such as foundations, beams, columns, slabs, and other load\-bearing components.
* Coordinate with structural engineers to ensure structural integrity and compliance with building codes.

**Joinery Detailing:**

* Prepare detailed joinery drawings for custom woodwork, cabinetry, doors, windows, and other wooden elements.
* Specify material types, finishes, dimensions, and hardware for precise fabrication and installation.

**Set Out Detailing:**

* Develop set\-out drawings that show the exact placement of key structural elements, foundations, walls, columns, and other critical components on the construction site.
* Ensure accurate alignment and positioning according to the architectural design.

**Set Out Plan Preparation:**

* Create set\-out plans that provide clear instructions on the layout of the building on the site, ensuring that all measurements are precise and aligned with the design documents.
* Coordinate with site surveyors and construction teams for accurate implementation.

**Truss Work Detailing:**

* Provide detailed drawings for roof trusses, including dimensions, material specifications, and connection details.
* Collaborate with structural engineers to ensure the trusses meet safety and load requirements.

**Requirements :**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and other drafting software
* Basic knowledge of construction methods and materials
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering, drafting, or related field.

**Experience**

* 1\-2 years of experience in civil drafting (preferred)
* Experience in infrastructure, roadworks, drainage, or land development projects is an advantage Working Conditions

Job Title: Junior Full Stack Developer (MERN)**Job Overview**

 The EMR Business Analyst plays a critical role in bridging the gap between healthcare operations and technology solutions. This position is responsible for analyzing, documenting, and managing business processes related to Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems. The EMR BA collaborates with stakeholders, including healthcare providers, IT professionals, and administrative staff, to ensure the effective implementation and optimization of EMR systems.

 Elicit and document business requirements from key stakeholders to understand their needs related to EMR functionalities.
 



 Analyze and translate business requirements into technical specifications for EMR system enhancements and implementations.
 



 Conduct thorough analysis of existing business processes related to EMR usage and identify areas for improvement.

 Collaborate with IT teams to ensure successful implementation and integration of EMR systems.

 Work closely with data analysts to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and security of EMR data.
 



 Develop and maintain data mapping and data transformation processes for EMR\-related data.
 



 Develop training materials and provide training sessions for end\-users on EMR system functionalities.
 



 Provide ongoing support to users, troubleshoot issues, and address user concerns related to EMR usage.
 



 Develop and execute test plans to ensure the quality and reliability of EMR system implementations.
 



 Collaborate with testing teams to identify and resolve issues during the testing phase.

 A bachelor's degree in healthcare management, health informatics, business administration, or a related field. Additional certifications in healthcare compliance or informatics are beneficial.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex regulatory concepts to non\-technical stakeholders clearly.

 Strong focus on accuracy and precision in compliance analysis and documentation.
 



 Ability to adapt to changing regulatory requirements and healthcare industry trends.

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Accounting \& Reporting Manager \- Account### 

**Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)**  

  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support accounts payable activities in line with defined policies, procedures, and strategies. Each day, you will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely processing of accounts payable transactions. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing comprehensive reports and analysis to support effective decision\-making.  

  

The work model for the role is: onsite/ Li \#  

  

You will be mainly accountable for:* Performing quality checks on financial reporting data, including fluctuations monitoring.
* Complying with and helping achieve Internal control over Financial Reporting (ICoFR) compliance in Accounts Payable team for applicable templates and participating in internal control testing and prepares relevant documentation.
* Assisting in the timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, ensuring all necessary documentation and approvals are in place.
* Inputting invoice and payment information into the accounting system with a high level of accuracy and assisting in reconciling vendor statements to ensure all outstanding payments are accounted for and resolved promptly.
  

**Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)*** Highly Skilled in Account Payables, SAP FICO, P2P (Procure\-to\-Pay) \& Invoice processing. Should be flexible to work in shifts.
* Good to have experience on Invoice processing tool\-Basware/VIM or Direct posting in SAP.
* Experience in Journal entries of P2P cycle, GRIR process \& Vendor reconciliation is preferable.
* Freshers or 1 year of experience in Accounts Payables.
* Possess an enhanced knowledge \& Proficiency in MS Excel.
* Degree or Master’s Degree in Commerce
* You are at ease communicating in English and Good Problem Solving Skills.
* Hold a valid work permit to work in India.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**About Us:** 




 Saras AI Institute is the world's first US\-approved, online, AI\-exclusive degree\-granting institution. We are on a mission to make world\-class AI education accessible to learners globally. As we grow, we are building a people\-first team that is driven, ambitious, and passionate about creating something truly extraordinary.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic HR Intern to join our Human Resources team for a structured 6\-month internship. This is not your average internship you will work directly alongside our HR Manager, supporting real hiring, real operations, and real HR challenges from day one.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition** 



* Support end\-to\-end recruitment — sourcing candidates, screening profiles, and scheduling interviews for live open positions.
* Coordinate with candidates and internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth and efficient hiring process.
* Maintain and regularly update candidate databases, hiring trackers, and recruitment pipelines.
* Help draft job descriptions and manage postings across relevant platforms.



**Onboarding \& Documentation** 



* Support the onboarding process for new hires — managing joining documentation and induction coordination.
* Ensure a smooth and welcoming first\-day experience for every new team member.



**Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement initiatives and HR activities.
* Contribute to building and maintaining a positive and inclusive team culture.



**HR Operations \& Administration** 



* Support the HR Manager across day\-to\-day HR operations and administrative tasks.
* Help maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records and HR databases.
* Assist with attendance tracking, leave management, and general HR queries.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 



* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills — comfortable engaging with candidates and internal teams alike.
* Organised, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Basic working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* A proactive, ownership\-driven mindset with a genuine eagerness to learn and grow.
* Someone who takes initiative and does not wait to be told what needs to be done.



  





**What You Will Gain** 



* Hands\-on experience across core HR functions — recruitment, onboarding, operations, and employee engagement.
* Direct mentorship and day\-to\-day learning from an experienced HR Manager.
* Exposure to a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment.
* The opportunity to work with a driven, ambitious team building something truly first\-of\-its\-kind in global AI education.
* **Potential for full\-time conversion based on performance** 
 — we believe in growing talent from within.



  





**Why Join Saras** 




 At Saras, you will not just be an intern completing tasks. You will be a contributing member of a team that is building the future of AI education. Every day here is an opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact.

 Act as a strategic HR Business Partner to the GBS India leadership team, enabling business growth through people, organization, and culture. Drive the design and execution of a future\-ready people strategy aligned with global priorities, while contextualizing for the India market. HR Lead position for the GBS location in India.

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner closely with the GBS India Head and global functional leaders to co\-create and execute the people strategy aligned to business goals

* Translate business priorities into actionable HR interventions that drive performance, productivity, and engagement
* HR Lead role in GBS India, responsible for building the GBS hub in the location, shaping the people agenda during high\-growth phases
* Enable sustainable scaling by designing structures, leadership capability, and talent pipelines
* Drive end\-to\-end talent agenda, including workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development
* Design and implement localized solutions for career pathing, retention, and engagement tailored to the India talent market

* Coach and influence senior leaders on people\-related decisions, team effectiveness, and leadership behaviors
* Support leaders in building high\-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams
* Recommend and implement HR policies and practices aligned with global standards while ensuring local compliance and relevance
* Drive consistency, fairness, and transparency in people practices
* Build strong partnerships with global HR, Talent Acquisition, Rewards, Finance, and other cross\-functional teams

* Monitor key metrics (attrition, engagement, performance) and drive targeted interventions


**KEY RELATIONSHIPS**
* GBS India Business Unit Head and Leadership Team
* Global HR Business Partners
* Centers of Excellence (Talent, Learning, Rewards)
* Talent Acquisition
* Finance / Controlling
* External vendors / institutions


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate business strategy into people strategy
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership level
* Proven ability to operate in a global, matrixed organization
* Strategic thinking combined with execution excellence
* Strong data orientation and problem\-solving capability
* High ownership, agility, and ability to thrive in ambiguity
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* MBA / Master’s in Human Resources or equivalent
* 10–13 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience as an HR Business Partner in a global organization
* Proven experience supporting senior leadership and driving strategic HR initiatives
* Experience in setting up or scaling shared services / GBS environments is highly preferred

description:
**Job Description**
**Talent Acquisition**
 Develop and execute strategies to attract, source, and recruit top talent.
   

  

 Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle, from job posting to offer negotiation in Success Factor (Employee Konnect).
   

  

 Foster strong employer branding and candidate experience.
   

  

 Build and maintain a talent pipeline for critical roles.
   

  

 Collaborate with hiring managers to understand workforce needs and ensure timely fulfillment.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) For TA**
 Time to Fill: Average number of days to fill open positions.
   

  

 Quality of Hire: Percentage of new hires meeting or exceeding performance expectations after 6–12 months.
   

  

 Offer Acceptance Rate: Ratio of offers accepted to total offers made.
   

  

 Source of Hire Effectiveness: Percentage of hires from various sourcing channels.
   

  

 Diversity Hiring: Percentage of hires from underrepresented groups.

 Assess organizational and individual skill gaps through surveys and performance reviews.
   

  

 Design, develop, and implement various training programs, including e\-learning and workshops.
   

  

 Support employee career pathing and succession planning.
   

  

 Track training budget and evaluate program effectiveness.
   

  

 Execute talent management initiatives.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) For L\&D**
 Training Completion Rate: Percentage of employees completing assigned training.
   

  

 Learning Program Effectiveness: Post\-training assessment scores and feedback.
   

  

 Employee Development Participation: Percentage of employees participating in L\&D programs.
   

  

 ROI of Training: Improvement in performance metrics or productivity post\-training.

 Create and execute initiatives to improve employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
   

  

 Develop and manage employee recognition and reward programs.
   

  

 Foster a positive organizational culture that supports continuous learning and growth.

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

 Directs the development and implementation of HR strategies aligned with business objectives, provides guidance on HR policies and practices, and fosters a culture of employee engagement and development.

 Acting as a trusted coach providing guidance to leaders and managers on HR\-related matters, including performance management, compensation, and benefits, etc.
   

  

 Aligning HR policies and programs for their business unit or region which promote employee engagement, retention, and performance.
   

  

 Analyzing HR metrics and data to identify trends and opportunities and develop a story to provide data\-driven recommendations to senior management.
   

  

 Collaborating with senior management as a strategic advisor helping identify and prioritize HR initiatives that align with the organization's strategic goals and objectives.
   

  

 Leading team of HR leaders to collaborate effectively with other Centers of Excellence and serve as thought leaders to the business and HR.
   

  

 Developing and implementing change management methods and materials to facilitate deployment of HR programs and processes within a specific organization.

 Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
   

  

 Global Perspective: Knowledge of issues, opportunities, and challenges for conducting business in the international marketplace; ability to apply global perspectives appropriately in a wide range of situations.
   

  

 Knowledge of Organization: Knowledge of the organization's vision, structure, culture, philosophy, operating principles, values, and code of ethics; ability to understand the value of aligning capabilities with business goals to support optimal performance.

 Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

 Strategic Thinking: Knowledge of the importance of "big picture" thinking and planning; ability to apply organizational acumen and competitiveness to identify and maintain focus on key success factors for the organization.

title: Manager - BPHR

 A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer\-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams across the nation, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high\-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer\-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

The role combines deep employee relations expertise with strong business partnership to coach managers, mitigate risk, and drive performance, employee engagement, and retention through effective leadership.

Responsible for managing the work environment, identifying workforce needs and ensuring alignment with corporate manager expectations, values and vision.
   

  

* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru/Pune, India is a requirement of the role. \*


**Mode of Working:** 
 This role follows a hybrid work model, with a primary base in Bengaluru. While on\-site presence is essential for key engagements, flexibility is offered for remote work based on business needs and team alignment.
   

  

**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Business Partnership \& Leader Enablement (30%)
* Act as a trusted strategic partner to business leaders, aligning people priorities with business goals and operating realities.
* Diagnose organizational and talent challenges through data, leader conversations, and employee insights, and translate these into effective people strategies.
* Influence and equip leaders to own talent decisions related to performance, capability, workforce planning, and succession.
* Use workforce and people analytics to guide leaders in making informed, sustainable talent decisions.
* Enable and drive Leader driven Talent and performance enablement
* Facilitate and drive performance management , talent reviews, succession discussions, and development planning—challenging leaders to build strong pipelines and readiness.
* Coach managers to identify, develop, and retain critical and high‑potential talent.
* Partner with L\&D and HR CoEs to support targeted development solutions driven by business and leader needs.
* Employee Relations \& Compliance (30%)
* Support the charter for internal and external compliance for the center related to all Employee Relations ad policies
* Lead and support internal and external audits, inspections, and statutory filings, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and documentation readiness.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks, driving corrective actions and preventive controls.
* Promote a strong compliance\-first culture with zero tolerance for deviations in HR practices and processes.
* Support resolution of statutory issues, escalations, and employee concerns related to compliance.
* Serve as the primary advisor to leaders on employee relations matters, ensuring fair, compliant, and consistent people practices.
* Coach managers on handling performance, conduct, and behavior issues with confidence, empathy, and appropriate documentation.
* Lead complex ER cases, investigations, and corrective actions while minimizing risk to employees and the organization.
* Identify recurring ER trends and proactively partner with leaders to address root causes through capability, process, or culture interventions.
* Employee Experience, Engagement \& Retention (20%)
* Partner with business leaders and extended HR teams to build a compelling employee experience aligned with culture, values, and performance expectations.
* Partners with the Division head and their management team to support the selection and implementation of strategies to increase employee productivity, performance and satisfaction.
* Use engagement surveys, attrition data, and qualitative feedback to guide leaders in meaningful action planning.
* Own and implement Employee Satisfaction survey and actions.
* Strengthen manager accountability for engagement, inclusion, and retention outcomes within their teams.
* Support key employee lifecycle moments (onboarding, transitions, growth, exits) through thoughtful design and leader ownership.
* HR Team Leadership \& Operational Excellence (10%)
* Provide guidance and oversight to HR executives or extended HR teams to ensure effective service delivery.
* Partner with HR Operations and CoEs to ensure seamless execution of core HR processes and initiatives.
* Drive adoption of digital HR tools and standardized processes to improve efficiency and manager self‑service.


**Skills And Background You’ll Need**
**Education:** 
 Graduate with Masters in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Psychology, Business, Organizational Effectiveness or related field preferred
   

  

**Experience**
* 10\+ years’ progressive experience with HR and Employee relations in a similar industry.
* Experience in HR compliance, labor law and project management is preferred.


**Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate**
* Strong ability to influence leaders and managers to take ownership of people outcomes
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of employees and division management; express ideas clearly and persuasively in written, oral and presentation form.
* Coaches managers to handle performance, talent, and employee issues directly
* Uses data, observation, and judgment to recommend practical solution
* Deep understanding of ER, compliance, and employment law
* Applies policies with consistency, fairness, and commercial pragmatism
* Handles sensitive situations with professionalism and discretion
* High emotional intelligence, resilience, and confidentiality
* Irreproachable integrity
* Ability to work independently, as well as an active member of both business and HR teams


**Why Join** 
**The Standard India?**

 The incumbent will play a key role in translating business strategy into actionable HR solutions while ensuring a high\-performance culture and strong employee experience through seamless execution of people initiatives across the employee lifecycle.

* **Strategic Business Partnership:**

* Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making on workforce and organizational matters.
* Drive workforce planning aligned to short\- and long\-term business objectives.



  




* **Deployment of HR Policies \& Governance:**
* Ensure effective implementation and adherence to HR policies, procedures, and compliance frameworks across the business.
* Drive awareness and understanding of HR policies among managers and employees.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure adherence to labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Continuously review and recommend enhancements to HR policies to align with evolving business needs.



  




* **Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:**
* Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to ensure structured and timely onboarding of new hires to enable faster integration and productivity.

* Lead performance management cycles ensuring goal alignment and fairness.

* **Employee Engagement \& Culture:**
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and action plans based on relevant employee surveys.
* Act as a culture ambassador, reinforcing organizational values and leadership expectations.
* Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.



  




* **Change Management \& Organizational Effectiveness:**
* Support organizational restructuring, role redesign, and transformation initiatives.
* Guide leaders through change management processes.
* Drive clarity in roles, responsibilities, and team structures.



  




* **HR Metrics \& Reporting:**
* Track and analyse key metrics such as attrition, engagement, performance ratings, and productivity.
* Present dashboards and insights to leadership with actionable recommendations.



  





*Essential qualifications, experience and skills:*




  




* Secondary/ tertiary qualifications in Human Resources, preferably from a Tier\-1 B\-School.
* Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in business partnering, preferably in sales environment in a multi\-country, matrix organization.
* Proven experience partnering with senior leadership.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive changes in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and operate in a matrix organization.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator
 



 Hybrid — Pune ONLY
 



**Salary: ₹6 – 7 Lakhs Per Annum** 




  





 Overview
 



 We are seeking a dynamic and organized HR Coordinator to join our team. This is a hybrid position based in Pune, offering a blend of remote and in\-office work. You will play a central role in our HR operations with a strong focus on end\-to\-end recruitment, onboarding and offboarding processes, document compliance, and HR process management — while ensuring full alignment with Indian labour law.
 



  





 Working Hours
 



 This role operates on late\-shift hours to support our operational requirements. Please review carefully before applying:
 


* **Shift Option A:** 
 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST (Monday to Friday)
* **Shift Option B:** 
 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST (Monday to Friday)
* Both shifts include a one\-hour lunch break.
 **Comfort with late\-shift working is essential for this role.**



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Recruitment** 



* Source, screen, and shortlist candidates across LinkedIn, job portals, and referrals.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews; liaise with hiring managers and maintain candidate databases.
* Conduct initial screening calls to assess qualifications, culture fit, and role alignment.
* Manage offer processes and ensure timely, professional communication with all candidates.



  





**Onboarding** 



* Manage pre\-joining documentation and coordinate day\-one logistics for all new hires.
* Design and deliver structured orientation and induction programs.
* Track joining formalities, collect required documents, and update HRIS/HRMS promptly.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new employees throughout their first 90 days.



  





**Offboarding** 



* Handle end\-to\-end exit processes: resignation acceptance, notice tracking, and clearance coordination.
* Coordinate full \& final settlement calculations and ensure timely processing.
* Conduct exit interviews and document feedback for organizational insights.
* Issue relieving letters, experience certificates, and all separation documentation accurately and on time.



  





**Document Compliance** 



* Draft, maintain, and audit employment contracts, offer letters, and HR policy documentation.
* Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws including statutory requirements (PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity).
* Coordinate background verification (BGV) checks and maintain confidential employee records.
* Keep all HR records accurate and up to date in both physical and digital formats.



  





**Process Management** 



* Maintain and update HRIS/HRMS platforms with accurate employee lifecycle data.
* Support payroll coordination, attendance tracking, and leave management.
* Handle employee queries on HR policies, benefits, and related matters.
* Support HR initiatives including employee engagement activities and performance management processes.



  





**Appraisal \& Bonus Cycle Management** 



* Coordinate and track appraisal cycle timelines, ensuring all stages are completed on schedule.
* Collate and organize performance data, KPI/KRA submissions, and manager feedback in preparation for review cycles.
* Liaise with department heads and line managers to ensure timely and accurate completion of performance assessments.
* Maintain all appraisal and bonus\-related documentation with full confidentiality and accuracy.
* Support the communication and rollout of appraisal outcomes, increment letters, and bonus disbursement documentation.
* Flag delays, gaps, or inconsistencies in the appraisal process and escalate where necessary.



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of proven HR experience with hands\-on exposure to recruitment, onboarding, and offboarding.
* Solid understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment including sourcing, screening, and interviewing.
* Demonstrated experience managing onboarding and offboarding processes, including exit formalities and documentation.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT), and record\-keeping requirements.
* Strong document management skills with attention to accuracy and confidentiality.
* Some experience working with HRIS/HRMS platforms — specific tools can vary; adaptability across systems is valued.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational ability with the capacity to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable working late\-shift hours (12:00 PM – 9:00 PM or 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST).



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources.
* Certification in Human Resources (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR, or equivalent).
* Experience working across multiple HRIS/HRMS platforms — breadth of exposure is more important than depth in any single tool.
* Familiarity with digital document signing, payroll, or BGV platforms (full training on our internal systems will be provided).
* Prior experience in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Knowledge of payroll processing and benefits administration in India.



  





 What We Offer
 


* Salary: ₹6 – 7 Lakhs Per Annum, commensurate with experience.
* Health insurance and benefits as per company policy.
* Hybrid work model — flexibility of remote and in\-office work (Pune).
* Full training provided on all internal systems and tools.
* Opportunities for career growth and development in a supportive, people\-first environment.

* Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
* High energy levels, agility and adaptability
* Exposure to AI\-enabled HR solutions, including GenAI and workforce analytics

* 6 \- 9 years of experience in HR Transformation and HR consulting domain

* Exposure to HR transformation programs enabled by technology
* Strong understanding of 1 or more HCM systems – Workday, SAP, PeopleSoft, SuccessFactors, etc.

 Experience in consulting for global organizations, across industry in the areas of:

+ Benchmarking and design of organisation structure

* Knowledge of Project management and development of a business case
* Working knowledge and / or experience in HR analytics, Learning design and delivery and HR policy design

Apart from day\-to\-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team

description:

 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience reading or debugging code with one of the following: Java, C, C\+\+, .NET, Python, Shell, Perl, or JavaScript.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience using techniques such as packet capture/packet analysis, artificial packet creation, load testing, and traffic path analysis to troubleshoot network latency, packet loss, and other performance issues at the packet level.
* Experience with any of these cloud solutions: SQL database administration, Google App Engine, open source software communities, Cloud networking solutions, or distributed computing technology.
* Experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting network infrastructure devices.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Routing, VPNs, VLANs, Peering, Load Balancing, etc.).
* Knowledge of Linux/Unix systems at a system/network administrator level.
* Knowledge of basic web technologies (HTTP, HTML, DNS, TCP, etc.).


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own our large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to our other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.
   

  

 In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Our Technical Solutions team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for our customers’ issues.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work as part of a team of Engineers/Consultants that globally ensure 24 hour customer support. This will include a need to sometimes work non\-standard hours/shifts, and may include weekends as needed.
* Manage the customer’s problem through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in Engineering, Sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Develop an understanding of Google Cloud networking technologies, including internal implementation details.
* Improve the supportability of Google Cloud networking technologies by working with product engineering teams, collaboration includes working with product engineering teams on product launches and to help product teams understand customer issues to improve existing products.

title: Antenna System Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 Take the next step in your career as a Senior Antenna System Engineer in Ericsson Antenna Systems, where your strong competence will directly shape the performance and innovation of the cellular communication industry.
   

  

 In this role, you will influence our product technology compass, guide R\&D efforts, and set industry benchmarks from within our organization. This role offers a platform to apply your comprehensive and deep technical knowledge, collaborate across functions, and drive technological leadership. As an expert, you will mentor peers, inspire creative problem\-solving, and strengthen Ericsson’s competitive edge. Together, we will continue setting the standard for antenna systems worldwide.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Drive best in class system performance: with profound and extensive expertise in Active Antenna Systems, radiators, signal distribution networks, filters, materials, mechanical aspects, and EM simulation tools, align technology, product, and operational strategies for innovative antenna solutions; create customer system value; assess maturity and cost\-effectiveness of technology for product; stay on the verge of industry trends and adopt relevant developments; identify disruptive innovations and explore emerging technologies to sustain leadership.
* Drive Portfolio Innovation: with a comprehensive system view of challenges and solutions, provide in‑depth technical proposals and systemizations for complex problems; assess portfolio break downs to sub functional technology levels in correlation to product KPI’s and industry benchmarking; identify portfolio harmonization and scalability maintaining product value proposition; participate in defining the direction of Ericsson’s R\&D activities
* Influence with Technical Expertise: impact business by influencing the whole organization and teams, as well as the customer, to materialize next generation antenna driven solutions in the market. Acts as technical lead and advisor for investigations and upper management in Ericsson.
* Drive Knowledge Sharing and Collaboration: promote learning within Ericsson and across the organization; act as teacher/mentor to inspire others and enable their technical growth; develop personal competence; foster cross‑functional collaboration; participate in or lead communities of practice and external academic collaborations as relevant.


**The Skills You Bring**
* Antenna HW for cellular systems
* Comprehensive and deep understanding of the network level impact of the antenna features, which enables optimal architecture ideation and concept selection, specifically within the segment of Active Antenna Systems
* Extensive knowledge on market \& industry requirements, Ericsson technical portfolio and competitor solutions
* Very deep understanding of Network KPI’s for Active Antenna Systems (AAS), beam configurations and correlation to antenna system architecture
* Highest expert level of competence in antenna system architecture, holistically and as a sum of its sub\-functions.
* Knowledge of radiator solutions for full range of applications and goals.
* Competence in the design of the radiator’s radiating and feeding sections, as well as environment components: cavities, directors, decoupling structures
* Expertise in signal distribution architectures, technologies (transmission lines, materials) and component design (power dividers, couplers, phase shifters, impedance transformers, filters, to assure optimal joint performance with the antenna front side and ultimately to enable the achievement of high level KPIs.
* Competence in the selection of and design with materials and solutions: metals, PCBs, dielectrics.
* Perfect understanding of the mechanical aspects that enable feasible, effective component and system materialization to the highest industry standards: possibilities, performance and constraints of materials and processes.
* Antenna EM modeling \& simulation tools
* Comprehensive knowledge of EM modeling and simulation tool possibilities that allow optimal antenna development.
* Personal skills
* Top level qualities as a leader: commitment, reliability, vision, creativity, flexibility, resilience.
* Excellent communication and influence skills.
* Confident fact\-based decision\-making.
* Embraces accountability.
* Balances empathy and practical sense.
* Personifies integrity.


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
